# TransientAmplification

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network property where small perturbations are temporarily amplified before decaying, enabling short-lived signal enhancement without persistent instability. Enables neuromorphic systems to perform transient computations and edge detection without requiring sustained oscillatory or chaotic dynamics.
